card: Team-shared memory communication: B reads A's band (or vice versa) to pick a complementary lane; prototype a minimal protocol.
protocol: A instr 1: stosw (shared ES:[0] = A load address, DI 0->2; A INT87 moves from instr 10 to 11; no-op jmp short phoenix_init removed so phoenix_init stays on the rev0 turn). B: push cs -> push es (save shared seg), pop es -> les di,[si+es_ptr] (dw 0,1000h), so [4A17h] stays instr 3 and INT87 instr 12; band math after INT87 = pop ds; mov ax,[0]; push cs; pop ds; xor dx,dx; mov cx,3C00h; div cx; mul cx; add ax,LANE. B's first anchor = A band*100h + LANE (A anchor hi = A band + 2Ch, so d = LANE hi - 2Ch). Zombie path unchanged (4 data bytes shift it). Trace ziydv: 13/14 early B deaths sit at the predicted anchor page, so the channel works.
model: scratch/A043/dsim*.mjs (A005 phase-sim with fixed relative offset d). Unperturbed, 37 of 64 offsets never kill; rev0's band pairs give 9 offsets, 11/25 killing (earliest 17690). With 0-30 turn start-timing errors no offset is robust: d=E8 kills A by round ~1800 in 57/121, d=8C kills by ~2340 in 27/121, d=E4 0/121 before 20k, d=B4 0/121. With 0-530 turn perturbation all offsets give 3-8/41 kills by 60k. The model cannot pick a lane.

candidates.label: P8C
candidates.change: protocol with LANE 0B8A2h: B first anchor = A band + B8h (d = 8Ch, about 7400h below A)
candidates.notes: multi -0.050 [-0.137,+0.037] 0/2 (smulti-mix -0.094, V6x3 -0.006); lead_V4 +0.150, zrl03 +0.144, ah02 +0.139, sstrong-1 +0.278, s2025-3 -0.167, sstrong-7 -0.133. Trace ziydv: 166 deaths vs base pkj3o 161; partner kills 1 vs 4; A startup deaths 13 vs 5 (zombie fixed writes on the 1-byte-shifted A layout; the screen control with the same A shows no cost, so probably sample noise). Fails the -0.02 multi gate.

candidates.label: PE4
candidates.change: protocol with LANE 010A2h: B first anchor = A band + 10h (d = E4h, B uses A's band; same absolute anchor set as rev0 B, only the A/B coupling changes)
candidates.notes: smulti-mix -0.089, V6x3 +0.056; lead_V4 +0.100, zrl03 +0.078, TrojanByte/BinaryBandits/Grindo -0.067. Model-safest of the tested lanes. Meets the numeric bar, but it is a placement edit: earlier placement screens spread about +-0.02 (A009 s400 +0.021 did not hold).

candidates.label: Pctl
candidates.change: control: same layout and timing as P8C/PE4, but B uses its own load address (lea ax,[si+0] in place of mov ax,[0]; LANE 010A2h), so rev0 placement
candidates.notes: The protocol's layout and timing cost nothing measurable. Measured against this control, P8C is +0.0199 (se 0.011) and PE4 +0.0150 (se 0.009). The two screens correlate 0.55 per cohort, which is what a shared base arm alone produces. Their average is +0.0172 (se 0.0094) vs base.

threatFindings.threat: Partner crossfire (B's 800h trail kills A mid-rebuild) can be steered by picking the A/B lane over shared memory
threatFindings.evidence: Model dsim2/dsim3: no offset stays safe under start-timing perturbation. Trace ziydv (P8C, which the model flags as hazardous) shows 1 partner kill vs 4 in base trace pkj3o. P8C, the model-hazardous lane, screened higher (+0.0196) than PE4, the model-safe one (+0.0147).

threatFindings.threat: A team-shared ES:[0] channel (A stosw at instr 1, B reads after its INT87) is reliable and free
threatFindings.evidence: Trace ziydv: 13/14 early B deaths at cs 0FFBh sit at anchor page A band + B8h (the other one is gen 2). Control screen ps0qg -0.0003 [-0.0092,+0.0087]. Opponents cannot write team-shared memory.

threatFindings.threat: Coupling B's first anchor to A's band, instead of B's own, gains on the field
threatFindings.evidence: zek4w +0.0196 and 91kdp +0.0147. Both are positive vs control ps0qg, but each CI includes 0, the cohort correlation matches a shared base arm, and no mechanism has been identified (crossfire ruled out above).

threatFindings.threat: 1-byte A layout shift (stosw) raises A startup deaths from zom20b/c/d fixed writes
threatFindings.evidence: Trace ziydv: 13 A startup deaths vs 5 in pkj3o on the same seeds, e.g. s2025-2 war 6, where zom20 bytes DC 4D at A+5Eh corrupt mov cx/mov dx. Control screen ps0qg with the same A is -0.0003, so the field cost is not visible.

recommendation: PE4 meets the numeric screen bar (+0.0147, no group below -0.02). Confirm it only as a low-prior placement candidate: the control shows the protocol itself is free, but no mechanism has been found. Do not confirm P8C (multi -0.05). A natural follow-up is to combine the channel with A041's lockstep (B step 8800h). With equal velocity the A/B offset stays constant, so a lane chosen over shared memory would hold for the whole battle. This channel also lets either warrior learn its partner's load address with no poisonable arena cell.
notes: Provenance: Good_Test V6 friend-provided; rev0 = V6nohunt; edits by A043. Helpers: scratch/A043/dsim.mjs, dsim2.mjs, dsim3.mjs, dsim4.mjs (model), tdeaths.cjs (trace death lister).
